title: Grateful Dead Live at Veterans' Memorial Hall on 1972-10-27

ai_review.summary: Muddy, low‑clarity recording with little high or low end detail and no notable musical highlights mentioned.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers criticize the sound, calling it muddy, lacking both high‑end sparkle and low‑end depth, likely a multi‑generation tape copy. No comments are made about the performance itself, leaving the show quality unknown.

ai_rating.rationale: Two low‑star reviews focus on poor audio fidelity; no information on musical performance is provided, leading to a very low overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muddy sound with missing high and low frequencies; likely a multi‑generation tape copy resulting in lack of clarity.
